row.company: Elite Metal Finishing and Machine Sciences
row.headline: Aerospace, defense suppliers plan to invest $40M, create 240-plus jobs in Cedar Park
row.summary: Elite Metal Finishing and Machine Sciences will invest $40 million into a Cedar Park industrial facility, bringing 240 jobs to the Austin-area aerospace hub.

rows.corrected_summary: Elite Metal Finishing will invest $10 million in a Cedar Park, Texas facility and create 170 jobs under an incentive agreement the city approved on 2026-09-10. It is one of two unaffiliated aerospace and defense suppliers the same story covers.
rows.corrected_talent_readthrough: Elite Metal Finishing is investing $10 million in a Cedar Park manufacturing facility and adding 170 aerospace and defense jobs there, giving recruiters a concrete manufacturing headcount target in the Austin aerospace hub.

rows.corrected_summary: Machine Sciences Corporation will invest about $32 million in a Cedar Park, Texas facility and create 70 jobs under an incentive agreement the city approved on 2026-09-10. It is one of two unaffiliated aerospace and defense suppliers the same story covers.
rows.corrected_talent_readthrough: Machine Sciences Corporation is investing about $32 million in a Cedar Park manufacturing facility and adding 70 aerospace and defense jobs there, a second, separate manufacturing headcount target in the Austin aerospace hub.

ruled_by: two independent agent reviewers under the owner's standing delegation of 2026-09-16
ruling: The row merges TWO unaffiliated companies that signed separate incentive agreements with Cedar Park, Texas on 2026-09-10 (story 2026-09-11): Elite Metal Finishing, $10 million and 170 jobs, and Machine Sciences Corporation, about $32 million and 70 jobs. Sources: communityimpact.com "cedar-park-slated-for-2-new-aerospace-and-military-manufacturing-companies" and connectcre.com "cedar-park-offers-incentive-packages-to-two-manufacturers".
reasoning: Two reviewers with web access read both outlets independently on 2026-09-21 and returned the same correction. The headline's $40M and 240-plus jobs are the outlet's sum across two employers, and no employer called "Elite Metal Finishing and Machine Sciences" exists. Both resulting rows keep money_basis and deal_type outbound_investment (the employer is the one paying, so neither figure is in the raise total), site_event opened, country US, and the original source URL and date.
note: Elite Metal / Machine Sciences: one merged row split into the two employers the story covers, by two-reviewer ruling of 2026-09-21. Elite Metal Finishing $10 million, 170 jobs; Machine Sciences Corporation about $32 million, 70 jobs; both outbound_investment and outside the raise total.
